app_id.description: Feishu/Lark self-built app_id used for tenant_access_token.

app_secret.description: Feishu/Lark self-built app_secret used for tenant_access_token.

brand.description: Select Feishu or Lark open platform domain.

skills_dir.description: Relative or absolute path to the skills directory used by /feishu_skill lookup.

max_search_results.description: Maximum number of search results returned by /feishu_skill.

enable_doc.description: Enable document operations, including doc create behavior tools.

enable_bitable.description: Enable bitable operations, including app/table/record create behavior tools.

allow_mutation.description: Allow create and update style operations. Must be true for doc and bitable create behavior tools.

allow_dangerous_actions.description: Allow delete and overwrite style operations.

show_zip_path.description: Show full zip path in /feishu_skill zip output.
